CookiePolicy.choicesP1: A {choice} yerɓaneego sitatistik kukys. A waaway cannjugoɗum ɗo'o:
CookiePolicy.cookieP1: Hoɗorde Global University e naftoroo kukis ngam siryaago bee aynugo kuudal maaɗa, raarugo ɗuuɗoral, bee ɓeydugo no siryaaji maɓɓe njahirta bee no ɗi kuwirta. Kukis ɗum ɗereehon binndol kon website kuutinirta ngam hoytinango huutinirooɓe kuugal.
CookiePolicy.cookieP2: Dookaaji sirrugo (GDPR e CCPA) njaɓii min sigoo kukis nder kompiita maaɗa to bannda maaji siryaaji ƴamaaɗi kuwataa. Kukis luttuɗi fuu, sey bee yerduye maaɗa.
CookiePolicy.cookieP3: Hoɗorde Global University e huutinira kukis feere-feere. Goɗɗi ɗum doole huutinirgoɗi, luttuɗi ɗum giɗaaɗi ɗi nafay bee raartugo. Koo ndeye a foti sannja koo itta yerduye maaɗa.
CookiePolicy.cookieP4: Janngu dow no min kuutinirta data maaɗa haa ɗerewol amin: Nufooji Huutinirgo bee Haala Sirru.
CookiePolicy.cookieP5: Kukis ɗum doole huutinirgo e naftoroo website ngam labangal ɗerewol e raarugo babe ketaaɗe. Website ɗu'um huwataa boɗɗum bannda kukis.
CookiePolicy.csrftokenCookiePurpose: Ngam aynugo ɗerewol hokkugo junngo, bee haɗugo goɗɗo feere nasta burawsa maaɗa huutinira innde ma bannda yerduye maaɗa.
CookiePolicy.kolibriCookieConsentPurpose: E ɗum nafa ngam anndugo koo koɗo jaɓiino huutinirgo kukis cuɓeteeɗi ɗin koo mo jaɓaayi. Ngam taa' ɗum ƴamamo dow haala ka'a fahin.
CookiePolicy.kolibriCookiePurpose: Ngam aynugo nastirde sumpo maaɗa bee hokkugoma laawol sirru ngi'a data maaɗa.
CookiePolicy.statisticsCookiesP1: Kukis sitatistik e nafa marɓe website bee heɓtugo kuudal hoɓɓe maɓɓe e website feere-feere, nden bee heɓtugo e hokkutugo anndinoore nder sirru.
CookiePolicy.visitorIdPurpose: E ɗum winnda ID wajjiɗinaaɗum ngam heɓugo data sitatistik dow no koɗo mo anndaaka huutiniri website.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriAboutP1: Foundation for Learning Equality, Inc. waɗi software Global University. A taway anndinoore feere bee dookaaji huutinirgo e nufooji sirrugo Global University taa raari ɗo'o:
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriAboutP2: Global University e waawi huwugo bee kompiita feere-feere, koo to internet walaa.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriAboutP3: Ɓaawo waɗugo Global University nder serwar kompiita, a waaway huutinirgo bannda internet. Global University e woodi nder serwar kompiitaaji ɗuɗɗi koo toye nder duuniyaaru. Kala marɗo serwar Global University fuu hakkilanaɗum, aynaɗum.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriAboutP4: Dawrooɓe foti cannjindira data Global University maɓɓe bee data ruldere wuro Global University manngo. To ɗum waɗi, dawrooɓe wuro Global University manngo mbaaway yi'ugo bee huutinirgo data iri gure bote fuu. Fahin data nastay serwar ruldere ɗum himɓe "Learning Equality" kuutinirta, hollii kamɓe maa ɓe ngi'ay data ɗu'um.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriAboutP5: Ngam ɓeydanngo kuuɗe bee janginillum Global University, "Learning Equality" mooɓay anndinooje feere-feere diga Global University maaɗa to serwar Global University e hawti bee internet. E ɗum raarana koɗolle serwar IP bee tinndinooje kompiitaaji bana kuwinoojum kompiita bee wakkati kuutiniraaki. Fahin "Learning Equality" e raara limgal huutinirooɓe gure bote, bee hitaande danyarde fukaraaɓe bee limgal ɓiɓɓe worɓe e rewɓe, bee no fukaraaɓe ngiɗiri jannginillum feere-feere. Ammaa ɓe mooɓataa tinndinooje dow ko raarani haala sirru huutinirooɓe.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriOwnersP1: Huutinir bee Global University nder laawol ngol ngomnati mooɗon yerdi. To an mari serwar bee Global University, an woni aynoowo tinndinooje dow huutinirooɓe Global University.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriOwnersP2: Aynu data bee anndinoore huutinirooɓe Global University maaɗa bee hakkiilo. E ɗum raarani aynugo kompiita, suuɗugo dirayf, huutinirgo bee paltirgel semmbingel wajjiɗinaangel, hesɗitingo system kompiita no haani, bee waatugo firewall semmbiɗum.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriOwnersP3: To a sanjindiri data wuro bote maaɗa bee data dammugal Global University, a hokkay dawrooɓe dammugal nga'al laawol yi'ugo data maaɗa. Nden boo a yerdi huutinirooɓe serwar "Learning Equalities" ngi'a data maaɗa.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriOwnersP4: Anndin huutinirooɓe to ngonnda. To e woodi fitina bee sigorɗum maɓɓe ɓe noddete.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersL1: Senndugo paltirgel ma, jaɓugo goɗɗo feere nasta sigorɗum ma, hollugo soynde aynugo sigorɗum ma
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersL2: Ɗum foondi nastugo sigorɗum kuutiniroowo feere
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersL3: Ittugo, nyifugo koo wonnugo nder Global University ko aynata Global University
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersL4: Fitingo, koo wonnugo kuugal Global University bee halleende dow laabi fuu, koo haɗugo kuutiniroowo feere janngugo bee Global University
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersP1: Huutinir Global University deydey no ɓe ciryori. Ƴamu yerduye daadiraaɓe koo jannginooɓe ma.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersP2: Anndu himɓe feere mbaaway yi'ugo tinndinoore dow maaɗa.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersP3: Noddu dawroowo Global University maaɗa ngam heɓtugo anndinoore ɗum sigii dow maaɗa, bee moye foti yi'ande, noye hesɗitinirta koo ittirtaa anndinoore nden. Ƴamta dawroowo taa yi'i goɗɗo nasti sigorɗum maaɗa.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersP5: To a kuutiniroowo Global University kokkuɗo junngo, dawrooɓe bee jannginooɓe wuro bote maaɗa poti ngiʼa tinndinoore dow maaɗa, misaalu: innde maaɗa, innde nde kuutinirta, duuɓi maaɗa, hitaande danyarde maaɗa, lammba heftirgel, jannginillum ɗum ndaaruɗa bee no keɓuɗa e poondi. Gaɗuɓe Global University maa e mbaawi yi'ugo tinndinooje dow maaɗa ngam woʼʼingo jannginillum feere-feere.
UsageAndPrivacy.kolibriUsersP6: To a koɗo nder Global University, dawrooɓe bee jannginooɓe feere mbaaway yi'ugo jannginillum ɗum an bee hoɓɓe feere ndaari.
UsageAndPrivacy.openIdH1: Huutinirgo bee Global University ngam nastirgo app feere
UsageAndPrivacy.openIdP1: A waaway huutinirgo bee Global University ngam nastugo app-ji feere. To a waɗiɗum, sey app-ji ɗin keɓa laawol yi'ugo innde nde kuutinirta Global University, lammba heftirgel kuutiniroowo, bee inɗe maaɗa fuu.
